author: Ljungman, 1866

note.en: A tiny brittle star of rubble and algae, known here from museum collections. Disc size is an approximate field-guide value.
note.es: Una ofiura diminuta de escombro y algas, conocida aquí por colecciones de museo. El tamaño del disco es un valor aproximado de guías de campo.

evidence: GBIF: 30 records in the region (many are museum specimens)

sources.t: WoRMS: World Register of Marine Species, accepted name and range

recWhy: Counted 'in the region' (Gandoca-Limón box): GBIF: 30 records in the region (many are museum specimens); exact site not stated.
